description: React component 'ScheduleICU' providing a weekly calendar UI for scheduling ICU availability. It manages state for doctors, ICU rooms, selected time slots, and handles data fetching and user interactions such as opening a booking modal and selecting time slots.

methods.name: ScheduleICU
methods.description: Main React functional component rendering a weekly ICU schedule with interactive cells and a booking modal.

methods.name: formatDate
methods.description: Formats a Date object into yyyy-mm-dd string.

methods.name: handleCellClick
methods.description: Handles user clicks on calendar cells, setting selected date/time and opening the booking modal.

methods.name: onSave
methods.description: Handles save action from BookingModal; currently closes modal and logs payload.
